fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation circulated the draft Cybersecurity Bill 2026 for stakeholder review in August 2026, and opened a second two-day consultation workshop on it in Maseru on 2026-09-23 with the Lesotho Communications Authority and UNDP, as the Department of Information reports.
The Lesotho Communications Authority published a public consultation document on proposed amendment rules to its licensing classification and fees rules, 2024.
